messages:
jess: We need a short migration note + deprecation banner for submit->invoke; target next Monday.
tariq: I'll draft PR copy. Paste snippets and timeline pls.
maya: I'll author the guide page: minimal examples, param rename table, quick smoke tests.
andre: I'll create redirect + banner PR. Plan: 301 /docs/sdk/submit -> /docs/sdk/invoke with a 30-day banner.
notion-bot: REMINDER: enable auto-alias fallback for 14 days post-announcement; log fallbacks.
jess: Timeline: announce Mon soft, 14-day alias grace, 30-day prominent banner, 90-day sunset.
tariq: JS snippet: ```js
// old
const r = await client.submit({model:'text-v1', input:'hi'})
// new
const r = await client.invoke({model:'text-v2', input:'hi'})
```
maya: Note param rename: num_tokens -> max_tokens. embed dims: 1024 -> 1536 for embed-v2; include a python smoke test.
andre: Banner copy idea: "client.submit deprecated — migrate to client.invoke. See migration guide." I'll add redirect and 301.
jess: Action items: Tariq PR; Maya guide+tests; Andre banner+redirect; Jess announcement copy + inform support/SRE.
tariq: Will post PR link here when ready.
maya: Adding migration-snippets tag to the page metadata.
andre: Scheduling 15min with SRE to review monitoring for fallbacks.
jess: thanks — ping me if blocked.
